name: super-forms/super-forms
description: Third-party PHP libraries shipped inside the Super Forms plugin. The release build installs them from composer.lock; vendor/ is never committed.

ignore.PKSA-y2cr-5h3j-g3ys: firebase/php-jwt 7 needs PHP 8; google/apiclient on PHP 7.4 requires php-jwt ~6.0. Low severity (key-size weakness), not reachable: Super Forms only signs Google service-account JWTs with Google-issued RSA keys.
